To date, no serious omissions have been identified in the present proposed Treaty's provisions on environmental protection which would seem to require this alternative and there is serious question whether in the present political circumstances the Panamanians would accept such a Treaty. A new Treaty might also obligate the United States to provide assistance to Panama for promotion of environmental protection, the USAID Mission in Panama has already proposed a watershed management project and a number of water, sewage and resettlement loans are already under consideration by U.S. and international financial institutions. This approach provides greater flexibility in dealing with these problems than would efforts to spell out necessary environmental protection measures in a Treaty.
